verdict.rationale: Typesense's own docs show documents being added to an existing collection and then searched, so incremental adds are its own capability. Nothing in the pack covers updates, deletes, or how quickly new writes become searchable; the sub-50ms claim is about query latency, not indexing freshness. missing for 10: documented update/upsert and delete operations, evidence that changes become searchable in near real time without a reindex, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, document adds, updates, and deletes become searchable in near real time without a full reindex
